worldcombat.skill.electricterrain.summar: Press current into a chosen patch of ground: bodies standing on the field hit harder with Electric moves, the charge underfoot keeps them awake, and sleeping bodies are jolted awake. It treats both sides alike.
worldcombat.skill.electricterrain.use.1: Keep the team from being put to sleep
worldcombat.skill.electricterrain.descri: Press a field of radius %1$s blocks into the chosen ground, lasting %2$s.
Living targets in the field cannot fall asleep and stay awake for %1$s after leaving.
Stepping onto the field throws about %1$s sparks; Electric moves hit harder, for both sides alike.
Starts up in %1$s and settles in %2$s, both driven by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.electricterrain.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to press the current in, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.electricterrain.growth: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.electricterrain.prefer: On = surging: wider field (x1.2), longer awake window (x1.35), denser arcs (x1.4), but shorter life (x0.78) and cooldown +16 ticks. Off = steady: smaller and shorter awake window, but lasts longer and cools down 10 ticks sooner.
The companion only lays the field while a threat is within this distance; lower lays it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
Push the field at the foe
On, the field is pressed between you and the threat so the fighting line is charged; off, it is pressed at your feet to shield yourself first.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to lay the field.
